about: Hand-written episodic recall set (Phase 3 spec §8). Each query names the exchanges ('conversation:index') that would be a right thing to recall, or [] when nothing in the history is relevant.

exchanges: my sister Anna is coming to stay with me in May
Lovely! How long is she staying?
about ten days, she's flying in from Toronto
That's a long trip. Is it her first time visiting you in Leeds?
yeah, I want to take her to the Yorkshire Dales
The Dales are beautiful in May. Malham Cove is an easy walk with great views.
she's vegetarian too so we'll need places to eat
Leeds has plenty: Tharavadu does great veggie Keralan food.
I need to clear out the spare room before she arrives
Maybe make a list this weekend so it isn't a rush in April.
Pip has been limping on his back leg since yesterday
Poor Pip. Is he putting any weight on it?
a bit, but he yelps when I touch his paw
It could be a thorn or a sprain. A vet visit is worth it if it's not better by tomorrow.
the vet said it's a small cut on his pad
Good that it's minor. Did they give you anything to put on it?
antiseptic spray and I have to keep him off long walks for a week
A week of short walks then. Pip will be annoyed but he'll heal.
he's back to normal now, chasing squirrels again
Great news, sounds like Pip made a full recovery.
my dissertation draft is due on the 15th of April
How far along are you with it?
I've written the literature review but not the evaluation chapter
The evaluation is usually the hardest part. What experiments are you running?
learning curves for the agent and a grounding accuracy test
Those are solid. Plot success rate against repeat number for the learning curve.
my supervisor wants the results by the end of March
Then aim to have the experiments running by mid-March to leave time for writing.
I'm worried the grounding accuracy will be low
Low numbers reported honestly still make a good dissertation, as long as you explain why.
I'm thinking of going to Lisbon in December
Nice choice. It's mild there in winter, around 15 degrees.
what area should I stay in?
Alfama is charming and central, Baixa is flatter and easier with luggage.
I booked a flat in Alfama for five nights
Great. Take tram 28 up the hill, and try pastel de nata at Manteigaria.
can I do a day trip to Sintra from there?
Yes, the train from Rossio takes about 40 minutes. Go early to beat the crowds at Pena Palace.
how do I make dal makhani like my mum does?
Soak black urad dal and rajma overnight, then simmer slowly for hours with butter and cream.
how long should I soak the lentils?
At least 8 hours, overnight is best.
it came out too thick
Add hot water a little at a time and simmer for a few more minutes.
my mum says the secret is smoking it with charcoal
The dhungar method! Put a hot coal in a small bowl on the dal, add ghee, and cover for two minutes.
my laptop fan is really loud all of a sudden
Is it loud all the time, or only when you're running something heavy?
all the time, even when it's idle
Check Task Manager for a process using a lot of CPU in the background.
it was Windows Search indexing, using 40 percent
Indexing usually calms down once it finishes. You can pause it in Settings if needed.
it's still loud after a day
Then it may be dust. Cleaning the vents with compressed air often fixes it.
I cleaned the vents and now it's quiet
Nice, dust was the culprit then.
I signed up for the Leeds half marathon in October
Exciting! How much running do you do at the moment?
about 15 km a week
A 12 week plan building to around 35 km a week would get you there comfortably.
my knee hurts after long runs
Try reducing the long run for a week and check your shoes; knee pain often comes from worn trainers.
I got new trainers and the pain is gone
Great. Keep the long runs easy and build slowly.
I did 18 km on Sunday!
Brilliant, that's nearly race distance. You're on track for October.
I've got an interview for a data analyst job on Thursday
Good luck! What company is it with?
a health tech startup called Medly
Health tech data is interesting. Expect SQL questions and maybe a case study.
they sent me a take-home task about patient wait times
Focus on a clear story: what drives the waits, and one or two concrete recommendations.
the interview went well, they asked a lot about SQL window functions
Sounds like it went well. Window functions are a common favourite.
I got the job!
Congratulations! When do you start at Medly?
